name: popsicle
headline: ResoBit Content & Blog Extension: Magento 2 Blog
short_description: The ResoBit Content & Blog extension enables a full-featured blog system inside Magento 2. It allows store owners to create, manage, and display blog posts, categories, and tags, enhancing content marketing, SEO, and customer engagement.
author: ResoBit

sections.overview:
The ResoBit Content & Blog extension provides a complete blogging platform integrated directly into Magento 2, allowing store owners to create and manage blog posts, categories, and tags from the admin panel. The extension includes SEO-friendly URLs, metadata support, and responsive layouts that work across all devices to enhance content marketing and customer engagement. Store owners can easily embed related products within blog posts and customize templates using the extendable block system. The module supports customization through admin UI grids and forms, frontend widget blocks for displaying recent posts or categories, and integration with comment systems like Disqus or Facebook. Installation requires copying the module and running standard Magento setup commands to enable and configure the extension.
Create and publish SEO-optimized blog content to improve search rankings and organic traffic
Organize blog posts by categories and tags for better content management and user navigation
Embed related products within blog posts to drive product discovery and sales
Build a responsive blog frontend that displays properly on mobile devices and tablets
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/ResoBit/Magento-Content-And-Blog-Extension`
sections.usage:
```
Act as a Magento 2 expert using the ResoBit Content & Blog extension. I need to create a content strategy for [COMPANY], an [INDUSTRY] business. Suggest 5 blog post ideas that align with [COMPANY]'s products and target audience. Include SEO optimization tips for each post.
```
Copy

```
requirements: Claude Code or compatible AI agent
```
